title: Supervised Algorithmic Fairness in Distribution Shifts: A Survey
findings: This paper is a survey on algorithmic fairness and does not present its own findings on religion. It notes that the BOLD dataset, used for studying fairness in text generation, includes prompts categorized by topic, one of which is religion.
